title: Light Spanish Tofu Crema Catalana
description: A light Spanish-style dessert featuring marinated tofu, crumbly pastry, and a touch of citrus. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight treat or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Orange liqueur
ingredients.notes: such as Cointreau or Grand Marnier

instructions: On a lightly floured surface, roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a small bowl, whisk together the almond milk, lemon juice, orange liqueur, and honey until well combined.
Cut the extra-firm tofu into 1-inch cubes and marinate in the milk mixture for at least 30 minutes.
On one half of the pastry, spread the marinated tofu, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the tofu and press the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with the beaten egg and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the crema catalana on a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
While the crema catalana is baking, mix the citrus zest and chopped thyme together in a small bowl.
Remove the crema catalana from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Dust the crema catalana with the citrus-thyme mixture and serve warm.
